title: The April Day Thepeer's Founders Chose to Give the Money Back
conflicts: Amount returned: Ononye said capital would go back pro rata; investors were reportedly first told about 20% (~$460,000); one investor later expected about $350,000 of $2.3m. The story gives the investor's $350,000 with attribution. Founding month: April 2021 (founders' statement, TechCabal) vs August 2021 (TechCrunch 2022); the story uses only the founders' April reference.
notes: Founders verified as Kosisochukwu Chike Ononye (CEO) and Michael 'Trojan' Okoh (CTO) in TechCrunch 2022, TechCabal and Nairametrics 2024; the slate's 'Eniola Ajiboye and Chinedu' was wrong. The slate's 'key partner change' is not supported as such; the founders cite compliance issues that kept key wallet providers from launching or staying on, and that wording is used. Runway, 2023 revenue and the fraud-prevention pivot rest on unnamed sources in TechCabal and are attributed. No Y Combinator connection could be confirmed.
